0.0: I'm facing a very serious problem right now. Would you be willing to help?

yes.0: Thank you. The usual repairman is on vacation, so it falles to me to repair the broken clocktower. We need to find #b#p2040029##k as soon as possible and get the #t4031094# to him.
yes.1: #b#p2040029##k is somewhere in the #bAbandoned Space#k, one of the deepest parts of the Ludibrium clocktower. Please deliver this #b#t4031094##k to him. I'm counting on you.

no.0: You must be really busy. The problem is, the longer we wait, the longer the clocktower stays still. I know you're busy and all, but please drop by some other time and let's get this thing to work.

1.0: I am #b#p2040029##k. What brings a spry young thing like yourself here?

npc.0: Please get this #b#t4031094##k to #b#p2040029##k, who should be at the deepest part of the Ludibrium Clocktower, the #bLost Time#k. Only he can put it where it should be. Be prepared, for you're guaranteed to face some tough monsters on your way there.

item.0: Can I help you...? What? Olson sent you here? Then you must have brought #b#t4031094##k with you. But where's #t4031094#? If you lost it, then please go get it from Olson again.

lost.0: I can't believe you lost such an important item. Good thing I found it. Please don't lose it next time!
